description: This file defines a mock class for OpenCDM session callbacks used in testing. It includes mock methods for various callback functions related to content decryption module sessions, such as processing challenges, key updates, error messages, and key updates notifications. It also declares external callback functions and includes necessary headers.

classes.name: OcdmSessionsCallbacksMock
classes.description: A mock class for testing OpenCDM session callback functions, providing mock implementations for callback methods.

methods.name: processChallengeCallback
methods.description: External callback function to process challenge data for an OpenCDM session.

methods.name: keyUpdateCallback
methods.description: External callback function to handle key update events for an OpenCDM session.

methods.name: errorMessageCallback
methods.description: External callback function to handle error messages from an OpenCDM session.

methods.name: keysUpdatedCallback
methods.description: External callback function to notify that keys have been updated in an OpenCDM session.
